name: moonwitness-platform

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --success first "pnpm arsy:dev" "pnpm dock:dev" "pnpm headquarter:dev" "pnpm id:dev" "pnpm jizz:dev" "pnpm sentinel:dev" "pnpm harbor:dev" "pnpm moonsky:dev"
scripts.dock:build: pnpm --filter @moonwitness/types build && pnpm --filter @allah/sdk build && pnpm --filter @moonwitness/dock build
scripts.harbor:build: pnpm --filter @moonwitness/types build && pnpm --filter @allah/sdk build && pnpm --filter @moonwitness/harbor build
scripts.moonsky:build: pnpm --filter @moonwitness/types build && pnpm --filter @allah/sdk build && pnpm --filter @moonwitness/moonsky build
scripts.headquarter:build: pnpm --filter @moonwitness/types build && pnpm --filter @allah/sdk build && pnpm --filter @moonwitness/headquarter build
scripts.id:build: pnpm --filter @moonwitness/types build && pnpm --filter @allah/sdk build && pnpm --filter @moonwitness/id build
scripts.gate:build: pnpm --filter @moonwitness/types build && pnpm --filter @allah/sdk build && pnpm --filter @moonwitness/gate build
scripts.extension:build: pnpm --filter allah-vscode-extension check-standalone && pnpm --filter allah-vscode-extension build
scripts.verify:release: pnpm docs:check && pnpm contract:check && pnpm contract:index:check && pnpm lint:arch && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm extension:test && pnpm ui:test && pnpm ui:contrast && pnpm --filter @allah/arsy test && pnpm build
scripts.ui:test: tsx --test packages/ui/test/components.test.tsx packages/ui/test/skins.test.tsx packages/ui/test/audio.test.ts packages/ui/test/assets.test.ts packages/ui/test/endpoints.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --filter @allah/arsy-core --filter @allah/arsy-orm --filter @allah/arsy-plugin-auth --filter @allah/arsy-plugin-llm-gateway --filter @allah/arsy-plugin-sdui --filter @allah/arsy-plugin-storage --filter @allah/sdk --filter @allah/sentinel-radius --filter @moonwitness/types --filter @moonwitness/ui --filter allah-vscode-extension run build && tsx scripts/typecheck.ts
scripts.esp:build: pnpm --filter @moonwitness/types build && pnpm --filter @allah/sdk build && pnpm --filter @moonwitness/e-isp build

description: Unified MoonWitness & Empire of the Light ecosystem - GATE entrance, Dock, Headquarter, ID, JIZZ, ARSY, Sentinel
